اجلوذوا (form XIII)
# اِجْلَوَّذُوا (ijlawwaḏū) /id͡ʒ.law.wa.ðuː/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِجْلَوَّذَ (ijlawwaḏa)
# اِجْلَوِّذُوا (ijlawwiḏū) /id͡ʒ.law.wi.ðuː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِجْلَوَّذَ (ijlawwaḏa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
